newsitem.title: USA: TGF says Hinsdale Finl merger rejected.
newsitem.headline: TGF says Hinsdale Finl merger rejected.

text.p: TGF Investments LP said Hinsdale Financial Corp adjourned its special shareholders meeting after it failed to receive the required majority of outstanding shares necessary to support its proposed merger with Liberty Bancorp.
A Hinsdale spokeswoman told Reuters the majority of ballots received favored the transaction, but this was not the majority of total shares outstanding.
TGF has been recommending that shareholders vote against the merger as not being in the best interests of shareholders.
TGF said it scored a "first round" victory in blocking the merger.

"We are pleased that many Hinsdale shareholders agreed with our opinion that this proposed merger is not in the best financial interests of Hinsdale shareholders," said TGF managing partner Thomas Fitzgerald in a statement.
The Hinsdale meeting was adjourned until December 11 by Hinsdale management.
Fitzgerald noted, "It appears to us that the Hinsdale goodwill claim of $48 million, or $17.81 per share, has not been properly factored into the merger equation."
